src: Sehopotso sa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson MandelaKabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho kenela sehopotso sa bone sa ho hlokahala ha Nelson Mandela ka la 5 Tshitwe 2013.
tgt: Go keteka tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo ya ga Nelson MandelaKabinete e ikamanya le maAforika Borwa mo go ketekeng tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo wa bone wa ga Nelson Mandela fa e sale a tlhokafala ka la bo 5 Sedimonthole 2013.

src: Ka selemo sa 2018 naha e tla tshwaya sehopotso sa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa bophelo ba Mandela mme maAforika Borwa kaofela a kgothaletswa ho imatahanya le mekete ya selemo kaofela ha re tla be re isa tlhompho ho e mong wa bara ba bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa ba Aforika.
tgt: Ka 2018 naga e tla keteka tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo ya botshelo jwa ga Mandela mme maAforika Borwa otlhe a rotloediwa go ikamanya le mekete eno ya ngwaga otlhe go bontsha tlotlo go yo mongwe wa basimane ba ba golo ba Aforika.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa bonkakarolo ba bona diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tsa sehopotso sa OR Tambo ho phatlalla le naha mme e shebile hore ho tla ba le bonkakarolo bo tshwanang ha re hopola qhoku ya rona le Moporesidente wa pele ya kgethilweng ka tsela ya demokerasi wa Aforika Borwa, Madiba.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga maAforika Borwa otlhe ka go tsaya karolo mo meketeng ya tlotlo e e farologaneng ya ga OR Tambo e e neng e tshwerwe go ralala le naga mme e solofela go tla nna fela jalo ka re tla bo re gopola mogaka wa rona yo gape e leng Moporesitente wa Aforika Borwa wa ntlha yo a tlhophilweng ka mokgwa wa temokerasi, Madiba.

src: Sehla sa MonyakaKabinete e lakaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela sehla sa monyaka se tletseng thabo le se bolokehileng.
tgt: Paka ya khunologoKabinete e lakaletsa maAforika Borwa otlhe khunologo e e segofetseng e bile e rena kagiso.

src: Re ipiletsa ho bohle ba tla kena mebileng ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang tsa bona di maemong a loketseng tsela.
tgt: Re ikuela mo go bao ba tla bong ba tsaya maeto go netefatsa gore dijanaga tsa bona di baakanyeditswe maeto a matelele ao.

src: Basebedisi bohle ba mebila, bakganni le ditaaso ba lokela ho ikobela melao ya tsela.
tgt: Badirisi botlhe ba mebila, bakganni ba dijanaga le batsamayakadinao ba tshwanetse go obamela melao ya tsela.

src: Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) e tla kenya tshebetsong letsholo la yona la naha ka bophara bakeng sa sehla sa monyaka se bolokehileng mme bohle re na le boikarabelo ba ho tshehetsa SAPS ka ho ikobela molao le ho itshwara ka tsela e nang le boikarabelo.
tgt: Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) e tsenya tirisong letsholo la yona naga ka bophara la paka ya khunologo e e babalesegileng mme botlhe ba na le maikarabelo a go tshegetsa SAPS ka go tlotla molao le go nna le maikarabelo.

src: Lefapha la merero ya Lehae le tla tsebisa meralo ya sehla sa monyaka sa 2017/18 bakeng sa tikoloho ya meedi ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae le tla rebola maano a paka ya khunologo a 2017/18 mabapi le tikologo ya melelwane ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Sena ke mabapi le ho thusa hore ho be bobebe le bolaodi bo matlafetseng ba ho tsamaya ha batho le thepa ho kena le ho tswa ka hara Aforika Borwa nakong ena e hlokolosi.
tgt: Seno se mabapi le tsamaiso e e lolameng ya go kgabaganya ga batho le dithoto go tswa le go tsena mo Aforika Borwa mo pakeng ya fa go tla bo go iwa kwa godimo le kwa WEBTOKEN ikuela gape le mo batsading go se tlhokomologe bana ba bona ka e le maikarabelo a rona go tlhokomela bana ba rona.

src: Hape re ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi hore ba se tlohele bana ba le bang kaha e le mosebetsi wa rona ho hlokomela bana ba rona.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke ditlhatlhobo tsa Materiki tse di tsweletseng ntle le dikgoreletso tse dintsi mme e lakaletsa barutwana ba 2017 masego ka ba tla bo ba letetse dipholo tsa bona tsa bofelo.

src: Kabinete e thabile ha e le mona dihlahlobo tsa Materiki di tsamaile hantle ntle le diketsahalo tse tshwenyang mme e lakaletsa sehlopha sa selemo sa 2017 tse molemo ha ba ntse ba emetse sephetho sa bona sa makgaolakgang.

tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 28 February 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Puo ya Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha.
tgt: National Budget Speech.

src: Kabinete e ananela boitshepo bo tlokomang bo bonahaditsweng ke Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 tse ileng tsa tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the overwhelming confidence expressed in the 2018 National Budget which was tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.

src: Maemong a moraorao a ntjhafatso a hlwibitseng setjhaba sa habo rona se kgabane, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ikamahanya le mmuso ho hodisa moruo wa rona esita le ho thea mesebetsi ena e hlokehang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: In the recent spirit of renewal that has gripped our great nation, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to partner with government to grow our economy and create much-needed jobs.

src: Phokotso ya tshebediso ya tjhelete e kaalo ka R85 bilione nakong ya dilemo tse tharo tse tlang, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba mmuso ho bokellweng ha ditjhelete esita le kabong e hlokolotsi ya mehlodi ya ho hodisa moruo.
tgt: The reduction in expenditure of R85 billion over the next three years demonstrates government’s commitment to fiscal consolidation and the prudent allocation of resources to grow the economy.

src: Dikgato tse tsebisitsweng tsa ho sisithehisa sekgahla sa keketseho ya mekitlane esita le ho kgina kgaello ya ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete, di ntlafatsa moralo wa rona wa tsa ditjhelete ka bokgabane ebile di fa maAforika Borwa boitshepo matsapeng a bokamoso ba moruo wa rona.
tgt: The steps announced to slow the pace of debt accumulation and contain the budget deficit greatly improve our fiscal framework and give South Africans confidence in the future prospects of our economy.

src: Kabinete e kgodisehile hore bokenadipakeng bo tla bonahala kgolong ya moruo wa rona, bo tiise boemo ba moruo bo be bo tshireletse maemo a ho theoha ha botsetedi.
tgt: Cabinet is resolute that the interventions will reflect in our country’s economic growth, affirm its economic standing and safeguard its investment grade status.

src: Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 di tshehetsa bafutsana setjhabeng sa rona ka lenaneo le phethahetseng la thusetso ya setjhaba, le thuto ya boemo bo phahameng ya mahala bakeng sa baithuti ba tswang malapeng a futsanehileng.
tgt: The 2018 National Budget supports the poor in our society through a comprehensive social assistance programme and fee-free tertiary education for students from poor households.

src: Ho arabela dingongorehong tse hlahisitsweng mabapi le dikeketseho tse sisintsweng tsa Lekgetho la Boleng bo Ekeditsweng (VAT), Kabinete e lohotha ho atolla lenane la disebedisuwa tsa mantlha tse sa angweng ke VADilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: As a response to the concern raised on the Value-Added Tax (VAT) increases proposed, Cabinet is considering expanding the list of basic goods that are zero-rated on VANelson Mandela Centenary.

src: Kabinete e kgema mmoho le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa kgoeletsong ya hae ho maAforika Borwa, ya ho tiisa botjha boikitlaetso bo abelanwang ba ho sebeletsa setjhaba, jwalokaha re tswelapele ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in his call on South Africans to reaffirm a shared commitment to serve people as we continue to celebrate the centenary of the birth of former President Nelson Mandela.

src: Madiba ke Moporesidente wa pele wa Aforika Borwa ya Demokrasi mme o ne a tla qeta le dilemo tse 100 ka la 18 Phupu 2018.
tgt: Madiba is the first President of a Democratic South Africa and would have turned 100 years of age on 18 July 2018.

src: Madiba ke thatohatsi ya lefatshe lohle e tlotlehang lefatshe ka bophara e le Mampodi wa Ditokelo tsa Botho, ho se kgetholle ka morabe le ka bong.
tgt: Madiba is a global icon who is revered worldwide as a Champion of Human Rights, non-racism and non-sexism.

src: O bile le seabo sa bohlokwa ho kopanyeng maAforika Borwa, esita le ho kgothaletsa kopano ya demokrasi Aforika ka bophara le lefatshe ka bophara.
tgt: He played a critical role in unifying South Africans, and inspiring democratic unity across Africa and the globe.

src: Moketjana wa pele wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela o bile nakong ya Seboka sa Kopano ya Aforika Addis Ababa, Ethiopia ka Pherekgong ya 2018.
tgt: The first celebration of Nelson Mandela’s centenary took place during the African Union Summit in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia in January 2018.

src: Diketsahalo tse ngatanyana di tla tshwarwa naha ka bophara monongwaha, ho hetla morao bophelong ba Tata Madiba.
tgt: A number of events will be held throughout the country this year to reflect on the life of Tata Madiba.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a ikamahanye le meketjana ya dilemo tse lekgolo a le mesebetsing, dikolong, dikerekeng le mekgatlong ya setjhaba.
tgt: Cabinet calls upon all South Africans to join in the centenary celebrations in their workplaces, schools, churches and civic organisations.

src: E etsa kgoeletso ho e mong le e mong wa rona hore re hate menyabuketsong ya Nelson Mandela ka ho sebetsa ka mekgwa ya rona e fapaneng ho aha naha e kopaneng, e se nang kgethollo ya morabe, le ya bong e bile e le e atlehileng.
tgt: It calls on each one of us this year to emulate the values of Nelson Mandela by working in our respective ways to build a united, non-racist, non-sexist and prosperous country.

src: Naha ena e boela e keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa e mong wa baradi ba kgabane ba Aforika, Mama Albertina Sisulu, ya ileng a nyehela bophelo ba hae a lwanela tokoloho ya basadi le ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: The country also celebrates the centenary of one of the great daughters of the African soil Mama Albertina Sisulu, who dedicated her life to fight for the emancipation of women and the liberation of South Africa.

src: Kopanong ya yona e latelang, Kabinete e tla rala lenaneo la ho keteka Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Mama Albertina Sisulu.
tgt: Cabinet will in the next meeting also outline a programme for the celebration of the Centenary of Mama Albertina Sisulu.

src: Komello.
tgt: Drought.

src: Kabinete e ananela matsapa a matla a entsweng ke Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng ka komello, hammoho le ba amehang makaleng ohle a mmuso le kahisanong ho sebetsaneng le maemo a ntseng a ja setsi a komello a thefutseng dikarolo tse ngatanyana tsa naha.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the relentless efforts made by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Drought together with stakeholders in all spheres of government and society in dealing with the persistent drought conditions that have hit several parts of the country.

src: Ntle le taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ke naha e nang le leqeme la metsi, ditlamorao tsa phuthumalo ya lefatshe lohle di tswelapele ho ama mokgwa oo pula e nang ka wona, mme seo se etsa hore mothamo wa matamo a rona o dule o le tlase.
tgt: Apart from the fact that South Africa is a water-scarce country, the effects of global warming continue to affect the rain patterns, thus causing our dam levels to remain low.

src: Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Matona a Kopaneng se sebetsanang le Komello se tswelapele ho hlophisa mosebetsi dipakeng tsa mmuso wa naha, wa diprofense le wa bomasepala dibakeng tsohle tse thefutsweng ke komello.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial Task Team on Drought continues to facilitate work between national government, provinces and municipalities in all drought-affected areas.

src: Sena se akga ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikgato tsa nako e kgutshwane, e mahareng esita le e telele ho rarolla le ho nolofatsa ditlamorao tse ka etsahalang tsa komello ena.
tgt: This includes implementing short, medium and long-term measures to address and mitigate the potential impact of this drought.

src: Mmuso o bokelletse tjhelete ya ho fana ka thuso ya nako e kgutshwane diprofenseng tse amehileng.
tgt: Government has made funds available to provide short-term assistance to affected provinces.

src: O fane ka dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa kinolo maqakabetsing tse kaalo ka R473 milione esita le R6 bilione e tla eketswa selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2018/19 ho tlatseletsa meralong ya motheo ya metsi Kapa Bophirimela, Kapa Botjhabela le Kapa Leboya.
tgt: It has provided a relief grant worth R473 million and an additional R6 billion in the 2018/19 financial year to augment water infrastructure in the Western Cape‚ Eastern Cape and Northern Cape.

src: Mmuso o etsa kgoeletso ho bohle ho tswelapele ho sebetsa le mmuso ho bolokeng metsi, ka ho a sebedisa ka boikarabelo le ka paballo.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all to continue to work with government in conserving water by using it responsibly and sparingly.

src: Kabinete e dula e ntse e ikitlaelleditse ho etsa Aforika Borwa hore e be naha e tla kgethwa ke baeti le ke botsetedi ka ho tshwanang.
tgt: Cabinet remains committed to making South Africa a country of choice for visitors and potential investors alike.

src: Dipolao tsa Mapolesa.
tgt: Police killings.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho ba malapa le metswalle ya bahlanka ba bahlano ba sepolesa mmoho le lesole la mehleng, ba sa tswa fenethwa ka sehloho tlhaselong ya Motebo wa Sepolesa wa Ngcobo Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Cabinet expresses condolences to the families and friends of the five police officers and a former soldier who were recently brutally murdered in an attack on the Ngcobo Police Station in the Eastern Cape.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe polao efe kapa efe ya banna le basadi ba habo rona ba mapolesa.
tgt: Cabinet strongly condemns any senseless killing of our servicemen and women.

src: Ho shwa ha mohlanka a le mong wa sepolesa, lesole kapa motho e mong ofe kapa ofe ya sebetsang mosebetsi wa ho tshireletsa kahisano le batho ba habo rona, ha e a amoheleha.
tgt: The loss of one police officer, soldier or any other person who serves to protect society and our people is unacceptable.

src: Kabinete e ikitlaeditse, ka Letona la Sepolesa, ho etsa kahohlehohle kamoo e ka kgonang kateng ho matlafatsa metebo ya habo rona ya sepolesa, e le ho thibela ditlhaselo tse jwalo kamoso.
tgt: Cabinet has committed, through the Minister of Police, to do whatever possible to capacitate our police stations to prevent such attacks in the future.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho batswadi le setjhaba ka kakaretso ho netefatsa hore bana ba bolokehile ka nako tsohle, esita le ho sebedisana le makala a kenyang molao tshebetsong, ho tshireletsa ditokelo tsa bana ba rona.
tgt: Cabinet further appeals to parents and society at large to ensure children are kept safe at all times and to partner with law-enforcement agencies to protect the rights of our children.

src: Mokgwa ofe kapa ofe wa tlhekefetso kgahlanong le ngwana, o tlameha ho pepeswa o be o tlalehwe hanghang.
tgt: Any form of abuse against a child must be exposed and reported immediately.

src: Ha re sebetsa mmoho, re ka boloka dibaka tsa rona di bolokehile ra ba ra netefatsa hore baetsi ba ditlolo tsa molao ha ba fumane sekoti sa ho ipata.
tgt: By working together, we can keep our communities safe and ensure that criminal elements have no place to hide.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Leano le Lekotsweng Botjha la Pampiri e Tshweu ho tsa Dipalangwang tsa Naha le tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the Draft Revised White Paper on National Transport Policy to be published for public comments.

src: Leano le habile ho fana ka mokgwatsamaiso wa dipalangwang o tlamahanngwang le merero e meng e amanang le lekala ho etsetsa hore ho fokotswe ditjeo tsa ho eta le tsa ho etsa kgwebo.
tgt: The policy aims to provide a transport system that is integrated with other related sector plans so as to reduce both the cost of commuting and doing business.

src: Le boela le nyalanya merero ya dipalangwang ya naha ena le ditlwaelo tsa dipalangwang tsa lefatshe lohle.
tgt: It also aligns the country’s transportation plans to the global transportation trends.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tala Leanong la tsa Mebila la Aforika Borwa, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Green Paper on Roads Policy for South Africa to be published for public comments.

src: Leano le fana ka moralo o ka sehloohong o netefatsang hore mebila ya Aforika Borwa e laoleha betetshana, e batla e bolokehile mme e kenyeletsa mefuta yohle ya dipalangwang hore e fane ka mokgwa o tsitsitseng wa bolaodi ba mebila.
tgt: The policy provides the overarching framework that ensures South Africa’s roads are better managed, safer and include all modes of transport to deliver a sustainable approach to roads management.

src: Le tataisa melawana ya tsela, meralo ya motheo, polokeho, ditjhelete tsa mebila le dipalangwang tseo e seng makoloi.
tgt: It guides the road regulations, infrastructure, safety, road funding and non- motorised transport.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphumano tsa Tshekatsheko ya Naha ya Tswelopele ya Diphuputso le Boithutwane (R&D Survey).R&D ke karolo ya bohlokwa ya tswelopele ya moruo wa kahisano naheng ena.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the 2015/16 National Survey of Research and Experimental Development (R&D Survey).R&D is an integral part of the country’s socio-economic development.

src: Ana e bile matsapa a kopanetsweng a mmuso, diindasteri le ditheo tsa diphuputso.
tgt: This has been collective efforts of government, industry and research institutions.

src: Tlaleho e a fumaneha websaeteng ya Lefapha la Saense le Theknolji (DST) ya: WEBTOKEKabinete e ananetse metako e fapaneng ya lethathama la 2018 la tjhelete ya sehopotso e lewana, le tla hlahiswa ke khamphane ya Minte ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: The report is available on the Department of Science and Technology (DST) website: WEBTOKECabinet approved the designs of the 2018 commemorative collector’s coin series, which will be produced by the South African Mint Company.

src: Pokello ya 2018 ya metako e fapaneng e tla keteka Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: The 2018 designs collection will be celebrating the Nelson Mandela Centenary.

src: Dipokello tsena di ne di leleketswe ke tjhelete e lewana ya sehopotso ya 2017 e neng e keteka Aforika Borwa tlasa mokotaba wa Tokoloho, Demokrasi le Botjhaba.
tgt: These collections were preceded by the 2017 commemorative coins that celebrated South Africa under the theme of Freedom, Democracy and Cultures.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Bills.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Lebollo la Setho ya 2018 Palamenteng.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Customary Initiation Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Bili e habile ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa le ho laola karolo ya tsamaiso ya lebollo la setho.
tgt: The Bill seeks to protect, promote and regulate the governance aspect of the practice of customary WEBTOKEN provides national norms and standards aimed at the protection of life and the prevention of injuries and all forms of abuse experienced by initiates.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya 2016 ya Sehlomathiso sa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto Palamenteng.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the submission of the National Qualifications Framework Amendment Bill of 2016 to Parliament.

src: Bili ena, e hlomathisang Molao wa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto, 2008 (Molao wa 67 wa 2008), e matlafatsa Molao ka ho ntlafatsa dikgato tsa ho sebetsana le maemo a ho se bue nnete, e qobella hore ho be teng ditlamorao bathong ba sa bueng nnete ka mangolo a bona a thuto kapa mekgatlo e ntshang mangolo a thuto a seng molaong.
tgt: The Bill, which amends the National Qualifications Framework Act, 2008 (Act 67 of 2008), strengthens the Act by improving measures to deal with issues of misrepresentation, imposes consequences on persons who misrepresent their qualifications or organisations that issue invalid WEBTOKEN also proposes regulations to ensure that fraudulent qualifications are referred to the relevant professional bodies (database of individuals who misrepresented their qualifications).

src: E boela e sisinya hore ho be teng melawana ya ho netefatsa hore mangolo a thuto a boqhekanyetsi a fetisetswa mekgatlong ya seporofeshenale e tshwanelehileng (pokello ya lenane la batho ba sa bueng nnete ka mangolo a bona a thuto).
tgt: It also addresses the accreditation of foreign qualifications.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Bili ya 2017 ya Polokeho Ditereneng, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Railway Safety Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments.

src: Bili e habile ho ntlafatsa polokeho ya ditereneng esita le ho thea lekgotla la tsamaiso le lekolang mosebetsi wa Bolaodi ba Polokeho Ditereneng ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: The Bill seeks to improve railway safety and create a governance structure to oversee the work of the Rail Safety Regulator of South Africa.

src: E boetse e amahanngwa le Leano la Naha la Diterene mabapi le ho matlafatsa bodisa ba polokeho, esita le ho kgothaletsa le ho qobella boteng ba polokeho ditereneng tsa rona.
tgt: It is also aligned to the National Rail Policy regarding the strengthening of safety monitoring, and the promotion and enforcement of safety in our railways.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Bili ya 2017 ya Taolo ya Ditshenyehelo Ditereneng, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba le dipuisano.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the Draft Economic Regulation of Transport Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments and consultation.

src: Bili e rarolla taba ya dikgaello tsa taolo le bokgoni mabapi le phano ya mekgwatsamaiso ya dipalangwang e sa senyeng tjhelete ebile e le e sebetsang ka bokgabane.
tgt: The Bill addresses the regulatory and capacity gaps in respect of provision of a cost-effective and efficient transport system.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Aforika Borwa, e le Modulasetulo, e tla tshwara Seboka sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) sa Matona a tsa Bosebetsi, Kgiro le Tshireletso ya Setjhaba, ho tloha ka la 1 ho isa ho la 2 Hlakubele 2018 Setsing sa Diboka tsa Matjhaba sa Motse Kapa (CTICC).
tgt: South Africa will be hosting the Southern African Development Community Ministers of Labour, Employment and Social Security, as Chair, from 1 to 2 March 2018 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre.

src: Mookotaba wa seboka o re: “Kgonahalo ya mosebetsi o motle: Ho ntshetsapele bohokahanyi, momahano le ho kenyeletsa ba bangata”.
tgt: The theme of the conference is: “Horizon decent work: Advancing connectivity, coherence and inclusivity”.

src: Ba tla nka seabo ba tla akga balekane ba kahisanong – dikgwebo tse kgolo, tsa bosebetsi hammoho le setjhaba.
tgt: Participants will include social partners – organised business, labour and community.

src: Boemong ba hae e le Modulasetulo wa SADC, Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla kena maetong a dipontshano ho ya Angola, Botswana le Namibia ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa ho la 3 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: President Ramaphosa in his capacity as the Chair of SADC will undertake consultative visits to Angola, Botswana and Namibia from 2 to 3 March 2018.

src: O tla felehetswa ke Letona la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba, Lindiwe Sisulu le Letona la Lebotho la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Sesole, Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.
tgt: He will be accompanied by the Minister of International Relations and Cooperation Lindiwe Sisulu and Minister of Defence and Military Veterans Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Seboka sa Lefatshe sa bo-17 se mabapi le Kwae kapa Bophelo bo Botle (WCTOH) ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ho la 9 Hlakubele 2018 Motse Kapa, katlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho kopanya lefatshe bakeng sa Moloko o Lokolohileng ditlamong tsa Kwae”.
tgt: South Africa will co-host the 17th World Conference on Tobacco or Health (WCTOH) from 7 to 9 March 2018 in Cape Town under the theme: “Uniting the World for a Tobacco-free Generation”.

src: Sena ke seboka sa pele sa ho tshwarelwa Aforika.
tgt: This is the first hosting in Africa.

src: WCTOH e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho be teng kgato ya boitlamo ebile e fana ka lepatlelo la mebuso, mekgatlo ya setjhaba, makgotla a Matjhaba a Kopaneng, mekgatlo ya matjhaba, basebeletsi ba bophelo bo botle le ba bang ba amehang ho okgelana tsebo le ho thakelana malebela, haholoholo mabapi le batjha le basadi ba pepesehileng tshebedisong ya kwae.
tgt: The WTCOH calls for committed action and provides a platform for governments, civil-society organisations, United Nations agencies, international organisations, health workers and other stakeholders to discuss shared knowledge and experiences, particularly regarding to youth and women who are exposed to tobacco WEBTOKEN the conference contributes towards addressing the National Development Plan’s goals by creating awareness and education on the harmful effects of tobacco use, and the need to intensify tobacco control measures.

src: Ho tshwara seboka ho a thusa mabapi le ho tla le ditharollo tsa sepheo sa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha ka ho etsa tlhokomediso le thuto ka ditlamorao tse kotsi tsa tshebediso ya kwae, le tlhokeho ya ho matlafatsa dikgato tsa taolo ya kwae.
tgt: On the 10 and 11 March the IEC will open the Voting Registration Centres for people to come and register and check their registration details.

src: Kabinete e kopa bakgethi bohle ba tshwanelehileng ho ya diteisheneng tsa bona tsa ho voutela, ho tsoseletsa lenane la bakgethi e le ho hlophisetsa dikgetho tse akaretsang tsa 2019.
tgt: Cabinet urges all eligible voters to visit their voting stations to update the voters’ roll in preparation for the 2019 general elections.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso, haholoholo ho ba tla be ba vouta lekgetlo la pele, ho netefatsa hore ba ba le seabo tokelong ya bona ya demokrasi ya molaotheo ya ho vouta, ka ho ya ba ilo ingodisetsa ho vouta.
tgt: Cabinet particularly calls on first-time voters to ensure they participate in their constitutional democratic right to vote by going to register to vote.

src: Mafelo ana a beke a boingodiso, ke katleho e kgolo mabapi le pheletso ya projeke ya dilemo tse pedi ya ho fumana diaterese tsa bodulo tsa bakgethi bohle ba ingodisitseng.
tgt: This registration weekend is a milestone towards the culmination of a two-year project to obtain the residential addresses of all registered voters.

src: Diteishene tsa ho voutela di tla bulwa dipakeng tsa 08:00 hoseng le 17:00 mantsiboya ho thusa bakgethi ba qalang hore ba ingodisetse ho vouta, le ho dumella bakgethi ba seng ba ingodisitse ba falletseng dibakeng tse ding hore ba ingodise botjha diterekeng tsa bona tse nepahetseng tsa ho voutela, ba be ba lokise dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: The voting stations will be open between 08:00 and 17:00 to assist new voters to register to vote, and allow registered voters who have relocated to reregister in their correct voting district and update their address details on the voters’ roll.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Messages.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa matitjhere ohle a ileng a tlotlwa moketjaneng wa Dikgau tsa bo18 tsa Naha tsa Botitjhere, o neng o le Johannesburg ka Moqebelo wa la 17 Hlakola 2018.
tgt: Cabinet commends all teachers who were honoured at the 18th National Teaching Awards which took place in Johannesburg on Saturday, 17 February 2018.

src: Dikgau di ne di ananela botitjhere le boetapele bo tswileng matsoho mekgahlelong e fapaneng, ho akga le Kgau ya Katleho ya Bophelo Bohle ya Nelson Mandela, le Kgau ya Moprofesara Kader Asmal.
tgt: The awards recognised outstanding teaching and leadership in several categories, including the Nelson Mandela Lifetime Achievement Award and Professor Kader Asmal Award.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho Motlatsi wa Letona Obed Bapela ka ho hlokahallwa ke mofumahadi wa hae Constance Bapela, ya neng a sebeletsa naha e le molekgotla nakong ya ho hlokahala ha hae.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to Deputy Minister Obed Bapela on the loss of his wife Constance Bapela, who served the country as a councillor at the time of her passing.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Ramaphosa ho fetisetseng matshediso ho ba lelapa, metswalle le bomphato ba moikonomi wa sepolotiki ebile e le mongodi, Moprofesara Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, ya hlokahetseng a na le dilemo tse Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona Naledi Pandor ho ananelweng ha hae ke Yunivesithi ya Leiden e Netherlands e le Moeti ya Tlotlwang wa Oort wa Moporofesara wa Astronomi le Ntshetsopele.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in conveying condolences to the family, friends and associates of the political economist and author, Prof Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, who passed on at the age of Cabinet congratulates Minister Naledi Pandor on her recognition by Leiden University in the Netherlands as an Oort Honorary Visiting Professor of Astronomy and Development.

src: Sena se etswa e le kananelo ya katleho e tswileng matsoho eo Letona le e entseng ka ho tlamahanya saense, haholoholo astronomi, e le sesebediswa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya lefatshe lohle ebile e le molemong wa setjhaba.
tgt: This is in recognition of the Minister’s extraordinary accomplishment in harnessing science, particularly astronomy, as a tool for global development and societal benefit.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse netefaletso ya mangolo a thuto esita le topollo e tshwanelehileng.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Lerato Mataboge e le Motlatsi wa Molaodi e Moholo (DDG): Kgwebisano le Botsetedi Aforika Borwa, Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Diindasteri (dti).
tgt: Ms Lerato Matabogeas Deputy Director-General (DDG): Tradeand Investment South Africa, Department of Trade and Industry (the dti).

src: Shandokane Evelyn Masotja e le DDG: Taolo ya tsa Boreki le Dikgwebo tse Kgolo, dti.
tgt: Ms Shandokane Evelyn Masotjaas DDG: Consumer and Corporate Regulation, the dti.

src: Vuyelwa Vumendlini e le DDG: Leano la Moruo la Matjhaba le Lebatowa, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Setjhaba.
tgt: Ms Vuyelwa Vumendlini as DDG: International and Regional Economic Policy, National Treasury.

src: Joseph Tebogo Leshope e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Tshebetso wa SENTECMof.
tgt: Mr Joseph Tebogo Leshope as Chief Operations Officer of SENTECMs Vuyo Zitumane as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Amatola Water.

src: Vuyo Zitumane e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Amatola Water.
tgt: Adv Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele as Chief Ombud of the Community Schemes Ombud Service.

src: Moadvokheiti Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele e le Molekodi e Moholo wa Tshebeletso ya Molekodi ya Dikema tsa Setjhaba.
tgt: Mr Edward Mamadise as CEO of the National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications.

src: Edward Mamadise e le CEO ya Bolaodi ba Naha ba Ditotobatsuwa tse Tlamang.
tgt: Dr Sagren Moodley as the representative from the DST on the South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions.

src: Ngaka Sagren Moodley e le moemedi wa DST Lekgotleng la Diporofeshene tsa Saense ya Tlhaho la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Reappointments to the Patent Examination Board:a. Ms Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.

src: Pehelo ka Kopano ya Kabinete ya la 14 Hlakubele 2018Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 14 Hlakubele 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDintlha tsa Maemo a jwale.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwaretse kopano kwa Tuynhuis, Motse Kapa ka Laboraro, 14 Mopitlwe 2018Merero ya ga jaanong.

src: Kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Kgolo ya Ikonomi.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgolo ya moruo ya 1.3% ka 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela kgolo ya ikonomi ka 1.3% ka 2017.

src: Sena ke keketseho ya ho tloha ho 0.3% ka 2016.
tgt: Eno ke koketsego go tswa go 0.3% ka 2016.

src: Tshebetso ya moruo tlasa maemo a thata e lepa tse ntle bakeng sa menyetla ya kamoso ya moruo wa naha.
tgt: Tiragatso ya ikonomi ka fa tlase ga maemo a a boima e bonelapele ikonomi ya isago e e solofetsang ya naga.

src: Manane a kgolo ke letshwao la hore moruo o mathuleng a ho phahama, moo Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha le lebeletseng hore moruo o hole ka 1.5% selemong sena o be o akofele ho 2.1% ka 2020.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa kgolo di bontsha gore ikonomi e a tlhatlhoga, le Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba a solofetse ikonomi go gola ka 1.5% monongwaga le go oketsega go ya go 2.1% ka 2020.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala ohle a setjhaba ho ahella hodima mokoka o motle wa 2017, a be a sebetse le mmuso ho lokisa meralo ya ona hore e be kgato e tiileng ya ho tsitlallela kgolo ya moruo le ho thea mesebetsi.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maphata otlhe a setšhaba go agelela mo tswelopele e ntle ya 2017, le go dira mmogo le puso go fetolela maano a yona go nna tiragatso ya mmatota go tsweledisa kgolo ya ikonomi le go tlhola ditiro.

src: Tlhabollo ya Mobu Kabinete e amohela tshisinyo e ananetsweng ya ho hlomathisa Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 bakeng sa ho dumella kamoho ya mobu ntle le ditlhapiso.
tgt: Ntšhwafatso ya Mafatshe Kabinete e amogela tshitshinyo ya go fetola Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa wa 1996 gore o tle o letle go tsewa ga lefatshe ntle le tuelo.

src: Haesale ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o sebetsa ka matla ho sotholla masalla a ho nkelwa naha tlasa bokoloniale le mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: E sale ka 1994 puso e dirile ka natla go busetsa morago letlotlo la go amogiwa lefatshe ka fa tlase ga bokolianale le tlhaolele.

src: Mmuso, o sebetsa o itshetlehile ka molao, o se o entse boholo ho netefatsa tlhahiso e tswelang pele ya ditswamobung, ha ka nqa e nngwe o akofisa motjha wa ho lokisa botjha bakeng sa ba anngweng ke ho nkelwa mobu.
tgt: Re dira go ya ka molao, puso e dirile go le gontsi go netefatsa gore lefatshe le tsweledisa tlhagiso, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe le itlhaganedisa tsamaiso ya go duela bao ba amilweng ke go amogiwa lefatshe.

src: Taba ena e fetiseditswe ho Komiti ya Tjhebobotjha ya Molaotheo, e tlamehang ho tlalehela Palamente ka la 30 Phato 2018.
tgt: Ntlha eno e fetiseditswe kwa Komiting ya Tebosešwa ya Molaotheo, eo e tshwanetseng go begela Palamente ka 30 Phatwe 2018.

src: Dikgothaletso tse iswang ho Seboka sa Naha di tlasusumetswa ke letoto la dipitso tsa nonyo ya maikutlo a setjhaba tse tla latelwa ke dikopano tsa komiti.
tgt: Dikatlenegiso go Kokoano Bosetšhaba di tla laelwa ke metseletsele ya ditheetso tsa setšhaba di salwa morago ke dikopano tsa komiti.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba amehang hore ba tshwaele nakong ya mothati ona wa dipuisano, o tla tataisa ho utollweng ha ditharollo tse tla ntshetsa naha ya habo rona pele.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go baamegi botlhe go dira ditshwaelo mo tsamaisong eno ya dipuisano, eo e tla kaelang ditshweetso tse di isang naga ya rona kwa pele.

src: Re lemmuso o tsotellang o bile o sebetsa le batho, bohle ba amehang ba tla kenyeletswa nakong ya mothati ona.
tgt: Jaaka puso e e kgathalelang le go ikaega ka batho, baamegi botlhe ba tla nna le seabe ka nako ya tsamaiso eno.

src: Kabinete e boela e kopa setjhaba ho lesa ho inkela mobu ho seng molaong.
tgt: Kabinete e tswelela go kopa baagi go emisa go itseela lefatshe e se ka molao.

src: Re naha e ikokobeletsang molao ebile e rata kgotso, ka mekgwa e amohelehileng ya ho rarolla diqaka, ho akga le qaka ya mobu.
tgt: Re naga e e obamelang molao le go nna le kagiso ka mekgwa e e lekaneng ya go mekamekana le merero, go tsenyeletsa le morero wa lefatshe.

src: Aforika Borwa e dula e butse menyetla bakeng sa kgwebo, mme botsetedi ho tsa temo le bohwai bo amohetswe.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tswelela go amogela kgwebo, mme dipeeletso go temothuo le temo di amogelesegile.

src: Ho molemong wa Aforika Borwa hore e be le dihwai tsa kgwebo mme mothati ona o ka netefatsa hore re bile re na le manane a hodimo a dihwai tsa kgwebo tse atlehileng.
tgt: Ke mo dikgatlhegong tsa Aforika Borwa go nna le bagwebi ba balemi mme tsamaiso eno e ka netefatsa gore re nna le dipalo tse di kwa godimo tsa bagwebi ba balemi ba ba atlegileng.

src: Porojeke ya setjhaba sa Nofingxana ya Double Drift Wildlife Economy.
tgt: Porojeke ya Ikonomi ya Diphologo tse di Tlhaga ya Double Drift ya baagi ba Nofingxana.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Porojeke ya setjhaba sa Nofingxana ya Double Drift Wildlife Economy, Serapeng sa Diphoofolo tse Hlaha sa Double Drift Kapa Botjhabela ke Letona la Merero ya Tikoloho, Ngaka Edna Molewa.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Porojeke ya Ikonomi ya Diphologolo tse di Tlhaga ya Double Drift ya Baagi ba Nofingxana, kwa Serapeng sa Diphologolo sa Double Drift kwa Kapa Botlhaba ke Tona ya Merero ya Tikologo, Ng Edna Molewa.

src: Sena se ne se kenyeleditse ho fana ka lengolo la bonga thepa ho Mokgatlo wa Likhaya Lethu Communal Property (CPA) lebitsong la Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu, Mofumahadi Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: Seno se tsenyeletsa go newa ga makwalokano a bonno go Mokgatlo wa Thototlhakanelwa wa Likhaya Lethu (CPA) mo boemong jwa Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Magae le Ntšhwafatso ya Mafatshe, Moh Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: Setjhaba sa Double Drift se ne se nkelwe ditokelo tsa bodudi le tsa makgulo ke Molao wa Mobu wa 1913.
tgt: Baagi ba Double Drift ba ne ba tseelwa ditshwanelo tsa bona tsa boagi le phulo ke Molao wa Lefatshe wa 1913.

src: Ka 1994, setjhaba sena se ile sa kenya tseko ya mobu e ileng ya rarollwa ka 2012, moo ho ileng ha thehwa Likhaya Lethu CPLikhaya Lethu CPA e na le ditho tsa Setjhaba sa Double Drift tse 1 500 mme e amohetse R6 milione e tswang Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikoloho, ho ntshetsapele boiteko ba kgwebo ya diphoofolo tse hlaha polasing ya Naudeshoek (1 400 ya dihektara).
tgt: Ka 1994, baagi bano ba ne ba tsenya topo ya lefatshe eo e neng ya duelwa ka 2012, eo e neng ya tsala go tlhomiwa ga Likhaya Lethu CPLikhaya Lethu CPA e na le maloko a le 1 500 a baagi ba Double Drift mme e amogetse R6 milione go tswa kwa Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikologo go tlhama kgwebo ya ikonomi ya diphologolo tsa naga mo polaseng ya Naudeshoek (1 400 diheketara).

src: Selekane se ile sa sebetswa ka Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu.
tgt: Tuelo e ne ya tsamaiswa ka Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Magae le Ntšhwafatso ya Lefatshe.

src: Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: Banka ya VBS Mutual Kabinete e utlwile kitsiso ya Banka ya Resefe ya Aforika Borwa malebana le Banka ya VBS Mutual.

src: Kabinete e nketse hloohong tsebiso ya Banka ya Resefe ya Aforika Borwa mabapi le Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga botlhokomedi go tla thusa Banka ya VBS Mutal go busetsa dikgwetlho tsa yona tsa go bona madi le go direla dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba le babeeletsi ba VBKabinete e nna e ntse e itlamile go katoloso le phetolo ya lephata la ditšhelete kwa ntle ga go tsenya dikgatlhego tsa babeeletsi mo kotsing.

src: Letsholo la botsetedi.
tgt: Letsholo la peleetso.

src: Kabinete e amohela letsholo la ‘CEOs Know’ la Brand South Africa, ka tshebedisano le Boetapele ba Kgwebo ba Aforika Borwa, ho phahamisa Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka seo ho ka tsetelwang ho sona.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela letsholo la Brand South Africa ya ‘CEOs Know’ , e dirisana le Business Leadership South Africa, go tsweletsa Aforika Borwa jaaka lefelo la peeletso.

src: Sena se ahella hodima meralo ya rona ya motheo e maemong a hodimo, ka Lebenkele le Rekisang Tsohle la InvestSA, bokgoni ba diphuputso le ntshetsopele, ntlafatso le motheo o tsitsitseng wa tlhahiso ho tshehetsa batsetedi.
tgt: Seno se agelela mo mafaratlhatlheng a rona a maemo a a kwa godimo ka Lefelo la ditirelodintsi la InvestSA, bokgoni jwa patlisiso le tlhabologo, botlhami le lefelo le le setseng le le gona la go tlhama go tshegetsa babeeletsi.

src: Dibaka tse ntjha tsa kgolo le tsona di butswe moruong wa mawatle, ho eneji e hlwekileng, moruo o sa senyeng tikoloho le ho phopholetsa kgase ya shale.
tgt: Mafelo a mantšhwa a kgolo le ona a butswe mo ikonoming ya lewatle, eneji e ntšhwafaditsweng, ikonomi ya tlhago le go epiwa ga gase ya shale.

src: Letsholo lena le kenyeletsa Bahlanka ba Baholo ba Phethahatso (di-CEO) ba tswang dikgwebong tsa dinaha tse ngata empa di tsepame kahara Aforika Borwa, tse thakelanang tsebo ya tsona mabapi le botsetedi bo tswelang pele Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Letsholo le na le di CEO go tswa kwa dikhamphaning tsa dinaga tsa boditšhabatšhaba tse di leng mo Aforika Borwa ba arolelana maitemogelo a bona a go tswelela go beeletsa mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ka moya wa “Thuma Mina” (Roma Nna) o fokang naha ka bophara hore ba be le seabo sa bona ka ho arolelana dipale tse monate mabapi le ho aha lebitso le letle la naha ya habo rona esita le ho hodisa boipiletso ba yona ba botsetedi.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa otlhe go nna mo moweng wa “Thuma Mina” (Roma Nna) oo o rotloetsang setšhaba sa rona go tshameka karolo ya bona ka go arolelana dikgang tse di namatsang go aga serodumo sa naga ya rona le go godisa selebego sa yona sa peeletso.

src: Lenaneo la Phumantsho la Bahlahisi ba Motlakase ba Ikemetseng (di-IPP).
tgt: Lenaneo la Tshenkelo la Batlhagisi ba ba Ikemetseng ba Motlakase (IPPs).

src: Kabinete e e etse hloko taba ya nyewe ya Lekgotla le Phahameng e hlahletsweng ke mekgatlo e mmedi eo e seng ya mmuso mabapi le qeto ya mmuso ya ho tekena ditumellano tsa theko ya motlakase le di-IPP tse Taba ena e tla phethelwa ke Lekgotla le Phahameng ka la 27 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Kabinete e itse ka ga kgetse e e tlhatlhetsweng ke mekgatlo e mebedi eo e seng ya puso kwa Kgotlatshekelo Kgolo mabapi le tshwetso ya puso ya go saena ditumelano tsa theko ya motlakase le di 27 IPPs.

src: Ka moya wa matla a molaotheo le taelo ya molao, ho tekena ho tjhetjhisitswe.
tgt: Mo moweng wa puso ya molaotheo le taolo ya molao, go sainiwa go ne ga sutisediwa kwa pele.

src: Kabinete e tiisa boikitlaetso ba ho rarolla diqaka tse amanang le mananeo ana.
tgt: Kabinete e gatelela maitlamo a go rarabolola merero e e dikologileng mananeo ano.

src: Lenaneo la Phumantsho la Bahlahisi ba Ikemetseng ba Eneji e Hlwekileng ba Matla a Motlakase, le tla netefatsa hore basebedisi naheng ya rona ba fumantshwa eneji e theko e tlase ebile e le e hlwekileng, mme le tla tlisa matsete a hlokehang haholo kwano Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lenaneo la Tshenkelo la Motlakase o Ntšhwafaditsweng la Batlhagisi ba ba Ikemetseng ba Motlakase le tla netefatsa gore badirisi mo nageng ya rona ba neelwa motlakase o o phepha o le tlhotlhwa tlase, le go tlisa peeletso eo e tlhokegang thata mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Diporojeke tsena di tla fana ka mesebetsi ya moshwelella e 61 600, moo 95% ya yona e tla ba ya baahi ba Aforika Borwa, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo haholo ho batjha.
tgt: Diporojeke tseno di tla tlisa ditiro tsa leruri di le 61 600, 95% ya tsone e le tsa baagi ba Aforika Borwa, segolobogolo go lebeletswe thata bašwa.

src: Kabinete e tiisa botjha boikitlaetso ba yona ba selekane se tiileng sa lekala la mmuso le la poraefete ha re ntse re hahamallela mererong ya rona ya kamoso ya diphetoho ho tsa eneji esita le bophelo bo betere bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Kabinete e gatelela maitlamo a yona go kgwebisano e e tseneletseng ya puso le dikhamphani tsa poraefete jaaka re latela maikaelelo a rona a phetolo ya motlakase wa isago le botshelo jo bo botoka go botlhe.

src: Sena se a hlokahala ho tlisa botsitso bo batlehang haholo ba maano le bolaodi, le ho baballa boemo ba Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka se setle se ka kgethelwang botsetedi ho tsa eneji.
tgt: Seno se a tlhokega go tlisa pholisi eo e tlhokegang thata le netefaletso ya taolo, go tshola maemo a Aforika Borwa jaaka lefelo la boitlhophelo la peeletso go motlakase.

src: Listeriosisi.
tgt: Lesetereosisi.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang botebong ba pelo ho metswalle le ba malapa a ba ileng ba hlokahala kamora ho tshwarwa ke Listeriosisi, mme e lakaletsa ba ntseng ba hlaphohelwa hore ba fole ka potlako.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshidiso go ditsala le balosika ba bao ba latlhegetsweng ke matshelo a bona morago ga go tshwaetswa ke bolwetse jwa Lesetereosisi, le go eleletsa bao ba tokafetseng pholo ya ka bonako.

src: Batho ba fetang 180 ba hlokahetse mme ho tlalehilwe diketsahalo tse 940 Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Go tlhokafetse batho ba feta 180 mme go setse go begilwe dikgetse di le 940 mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Kabinete e kgothatswa ke matsapa a matla a Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, Setheo sa Naha sa Mafu a Tshwaetsang (NICD) le Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO) ho kgina kokwanahloko ya listeria hore e se ke ya jaleha.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloeditswe ke matsapa a a tseneletseng a Lefapha la Boitekanelo, Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Megare e e Tshelanang (NICD) le Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Boitekanelo go thibela mogare wa leseteria go anama.

src: Ho tswela pele ho matlafatsa matsapa ana, Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, le tla kopana le Lekgotla la Baoki la Aforika Borwa (SANC) ka Labone, mohla la 15 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Go tswelela go matlafatsa maiteko ano, Tona ya Boitekanelo, Ng Aaron Motsoaledi, o tla kopana le Khansele ya Baoki ya Aforika Borwa ka Labone, 15 Mopitlwe 2018.

src: Kabinete e ananela kgatelopele e ntle e entsweng mabapi le ho hlwaya le ho kotela sesosa sa ho ropoha ha Listeriosisi ena e bolayang.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga tswelopele e e namatsang e e dirilweng mo go supeng le go tlhaola motswedi wa leroborobo la bolwetsi jo bo kotsi jwa Lisetereosisi.

src: Kgato e latetsweng ya ho tloswa ha dihlahiswa tsa dijo tse tswang ditsing tse tharo tsa tshebetso ya nama tsa Enterprise le Rainbow – moo ho kokwanahloko e fumanweng teng – e ne e le nako ya bohlokwa ya ho kgina ho ropoha hona.
tgt: Go busediwa morago ga dikuno tsa dijo go tswa kwa ditheong di le tharo tsa tirelo tsa Enterprise le Rainbow – kwa mogare o bonweng teng – e ne e le motsotso o o botlhokwa wa go thibela leroborobo.

src: Lefu lena le fumanehang dijong le hlwailwe kgetlo la pele ka Phupjane 2017.
tgt: Mogare o o tlhagelelang go tswa mo dijong o ne wa supiwa lwantlha ka Seetebosigo 2017.

src: Listeriosisi ke lefu le kotsi empa le ka thibelwang la ba la alafuwa ka katleho ka tshebediso ya diantibayothiki.
tgt: Liseteriosisi ke bolwetse jo bo kotsi mme bo ka thibelwa le go ka alafiwa ka katlego ka di anthibiotiki.

src: Ba kotsing ka ho fetisisa ke basadi ba immeng, masea a manyane haholo, metsofe le batho bao masole a bona a mmele a fokolang haholo.
tgt: Bao ba leng thata mo kotsing ke baimana, masea a a sa tswang go tsalwa, bagodi le batho ba ba nang le masole a mmele a a bokoa.

src: Batho ba bontshang matshwao a feberu, mesifa e opang, ho nyekelwa ke pelo kapa letshollo ba lokela ho ya ngakeng kapa ditliliniking tse haufi hanghang.
tgt: Batho ba ba nang le matshwao a letshoromo, ditlhabi mo mesifeng, letlhatsa le letshollo ba tshwanetse go ya go bona ka bonako ngaka ya bona kgotsa kliniki ya selegae.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore Aforika Borwa e tla hlola ho ropoha ha lefu lena mme e kopa batho bohle ho lemoha melawana e mehlano ya boipaballo dijong nakong ena:Hatlela ka sesepa le metsi pele o tshwara dijo, le kamora ho sebedisa ntlwanaPhehisisa dijo mme o se ke wa ja dijo tse sa butswang kaha kokwanahloko e shwa ha dijo di butswitseO seke wa tshwara dijo tse tala le tse phehilweng mmohoBoloka dijo motjhesong o nepahetseng mmeEtsa bonnete ba hore dihlahiswa tsohle tsa lebese di hlwekile kapa bonnyane di hakonositswe o be o hlatswe dijo tse sa phehwang ka metsi a hlwekileng a phallang pele o di ja, kapa ka metsi a neng a bedisitswe.
tgt: Kabinete e na le tsholofelo ya gore Aforika Borwa e tla fenya leroborobo la ga jaana le go kopa batho botlhe go dirisa melao e metlhano ya pabalesego ya dijo ka nako eno:Tlhapa diatla ka sesepa le metsi pele o tshwara dijo, le morago ga go dirisa ntlwanaboithusetsoApaya dijo go fitlhela di butswa mme o seka wa ja dijo tse di sa butswang ka mogare wa Liseteria o swa fa dijo di apeilwe go butswaO seka wa tlhakanya dijo tse di tala le tse di apeilwengTshola dijo mo maemong a a maleba a thempereitšha le go netefatsa gore ditlhagiswa tsotlhe tsa mašwi di ntshitswe megare le go tlhatswa dijo tsotlhe tse di sa apeweng ka metsi a a elelang pele o di ja kgotsa bogolo ka metsi a a bedisitsweng pejana.

src: Ba nang le qeaqeo efe kapa efe e amanang le Listeriosisi, ba ka ikopanya le NICD ho 011 386 Ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Bao ba nang le ketsaetsego mabapi le Lisetereosisi ba ka ikgolaganya le NICD mo go 011 386 Madi a katlaatleloloago.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka boemo ba ho ba malalaalaotswe ha Lekala la Aforika Borwa la Polokeho ya Setjhaba (SASSA) ba ho fana ka mmotlolo o kopantsweng habedi wa kabo ya ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba ho bakgolamolemo ka la 1 Mmesa 2018.
tgt: Kabinete e ne ya tsopolelwa ka ga maemo a Setheo sa Pabalesego ya Loago sa Aforika Borwa (SASSA)a go siamela go neela mmotlele wa haeboriti mo go tsamaiseng madi a katlaatleloloago go baamogeladiatshiamelo ka 1 April 2018.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo (ConCourt) e laetseng katoloso ya konteraka ya hajwale le Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) ho fihlela ka la 31 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Seno ke go ya ka katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo (ConCourt) eo e laetseng go atoloswa ga konteraka ya ga jaana ya Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) go fitlha ka 31 Mopitlwe 2018.

src: Kabinete e thasisetsa boikitlaetso ba yona lenaneong la mmuso la thuso ya tsa kahisano, le tsepameng setsiketsing sa dikgato tsa rona tsa phediso ya bofuma ebile le le bohlokwa pusetsong ya seriti sa batho ba habo rona.
tgt: Kabinete e boa e ipoa kgatsu ka maitlamo a yona go lenaneo la puso la thuso ya loago, leo le leng kwa boteng jwa diitshimolelo tsa go fedisa bohuma le go busetsa seriti sa batho ba rona.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka hore bakgolamolemo ba dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa setjhaba ba tla lefuwa ka la 1 Mmesa 2018.Dikarete tsa hajwale tsa SASSA di tla dula di sebetsa ho fihlela ka Tshitwe 2018.
tgt: E kgotsofetse gore baamogeladitshiamelo tsa madi a klatlaatleloloago ba tla duelwa ka 1 Moranang 2018.Dikarata tsa ga jaana tsa SASSA di tla dira go fitlha ka Sedimonthole 2018.

src: Mothati wa ho fetola dikarete tsa bakgolamolemo o tla etswa ka mokgwa o sa belaetseng ebile e le o sa tlo sitisa ho lefuwa ha ditjhelete tsa dithuso.
tgt: Tsamaiso ya go fetola dikarata tsa baamogeladitshiamelo e tla dirwa ka tsela e e senang selabe eo e ka sekang ya kgoreletsa tuelo ya madi.

src: Bakgolamolemo bohle ba tla fumana ditjhelete tsa bona tsa dithuso tsa mmuso ka makala a bona a ditefo a akgang dibanka, Posong ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) le mabenkeleng a mang.
tgt: Baamogeladitshiamelo botlhe ba tla amogela madi a bona kwa mafelong a bona a tuelo a a farologaneng ao a tsenyeletsang dibanka, Kantoroposo ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) le mabenkele a mangwe.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba se nang diakhaonte tsa banka ho leba makaleng a haufi le bona a Poso hore ba ilo bula diakhaonte.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go botlhe bao ba senang diakhaonto tsa banka go etela Makala a SAPO go bula diakhaonto tsa bona.

src: Kabinete e laetse SASSA, mmoho le Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS), ho etsa ka hohle kamoo e ka kgonang ka teng ho tsebisa bakgolamolemo bohle ka diphetoho dife kapa dife tse ka bang teng motjheng wa diphetoho tsa ho tloha ho CPS ho ya mmotlolong o motjha o kopantsweng habedi.
tgt: Kabinete e laetse SASSA, mmogo le Lefapha la Tlhaeletsano le Mokgwa wa Tshedimosetso ya Puso (GCIS), go dira tsotlhe tse di kgonegang go itsise baamogeladiatshiamelo botlhe ka diphetogo dingwe le dingwe tse di ka nnang gona mo tsamaisong ya go fetoga go tswa go CPS go ya go mofuta o montšhwa wa haeboriti.

src: Kabinete e dula e ikitlaelleditse ho netefatsa hore mmuso o ikokobeletsa kahlolo ya ConCourt.
tgt: Kabinete e nna e ntse e itlamile go netefatsa gore puso e dira go ya ka katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo.

src: Dikantoro tsa SASSA di tla bulwa mme di tla be di le malala-a-laotswe ho sebetsana le dikopo tse ntjha.
tgt: Dikantoro tsa SASSA di tla bulwa le go siamela go tsaya dikopo tse dintšhwa.

src: Kabinete e kopa setjhaba sohle, haholoholo bakgolamolemo le ba malapa a bona, ho ikopanya le SASSA ho 0800 60 10 11 kapa ho etela kantoro e haufi ya SASSA, ha o batla ho tseba haholwanyane.
tgt: Kabinete e kopa maloko otlhe a setšhaba, segoloboglo baamogeladitshiamelo le bamalapa a bona, go ikgolaganya le SASSA mo go 0800 60 10 11 kgotsa ba etele dikantoro tsa bona tse di gaufi tsa SASSA go bona tshedimosetso go ya pele.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC) le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho leboheng maAforika Borwa ohle a arabetseng kgoeletso ya ho ingodisetsa dikgetho kapa ho lokisa dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona letsholong la bekeng e fetileng la boingodiso ba bakgethi.
tgt: Kabinete e ikamaganya Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho(IEC) le Moporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa mo go lebogeng ma Aforika Borwa bao ba neng ba reetsa piletso ya go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha kgotsa go tsenyadinakong dintlha tsa bona tsa aterese mo bekeng e e sa tswang go feta ya letsholo la go ikwadisetsa ditlhopho.

src: Sena ke mokolokotwane mabapi le boitokisetso ba dikgetho tsa botshelela tsa naha le tsa diporofense tse lebeletsweng ho tshwarwa ka 2019.
tgt: Seno ke kgatelopele mo go baakanyetseng ditlhopho tsa borataro tsa bosetšhaba le porofense tseo di solofetsweng go diragala ka 2019.

src: Palo yohle ya baahi ba 2 767 139 e etetse diteishene tsa ho voutela mafelong a fetileng a beke.
tgt: Palogotlhe ya baagi ba le 2 767 139 ba etetse mafelo a go tlhopha mo sebakeng sa beke e e fetileng.

src: Ho bakgethi ba fetang 2.76 milione ba etetseng diteishene tsa bona tsa ho voutela:Ba kahodimonyana ho milione ba ingodisitse botjha diterekeng tsa bona tse ntjha tsa ho voutelaBa kahodimo ho 800 000 ba fetoletse boingodiso ba bona diterekeng tse ntjha tsa ho voutelaBa ka bang 500 000 e ne e le bakgethi ba ingodisang lekgetlo la peleBoingodisong bo botjha ba bakgethi, 82% ya bona e ne e le ka tlasa dilemo tse 30 mme ba ka etsang 54% e ne e le basadiGauteng ke yona e neng e na le boingodiso bo botjha bo bongata ka ho fetisisa ka 23.69%, ha latela KwaZulu-Natal ka 18.78% le Limpopo ka 17.03%.
tgt: Mo batlhophing ba feta 2.76 milione bao ba etetseng mafelo a go tlhopha:Go feta fela milione ba ikwadisitse gape mo kgaolong ya bona ya ga jaana ya go tlhophaGo feta 800 000 ba fetotse ikwadiso ya bona go ya go kgaolo e ntšhwa ya go tlhophaBokana ka 500 000 e ne e le batlhophi bao ba neng ba ikwadisa lekgetlho lwantlhaMo dikwadisong tsa go tlhopha tse dintšhwa, 82% e ne e le ba ba kwa tlase ga dingwaga di le 30 mme bokana ka 54% e ne e le basadiGauteng e nnile le bontsi jwa ikwadiso tse dintšhwa ka 23.69%, e salwa morago ke KwaZulu-Natal ka 18.78% le Limpopo ka 17.03%.

src: Kapa Botjhabela e bile le boemo bo phahameng ba boingodiso ka 87%, ha latela Freistata hanyane ka hodima 82%, le KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo le Kapa Leboya ka 79% ka tatelano.
tgt: Kapa Botlhaba e nnile le palo e e kwa godimo ya ikwadiso ka 87%, e latelwa ke Foreisetata ka fela go feta 82%, le KwaZulu- Natal, Limpopo le Kapa Bokone ka 79% ka go latelana.

src: Bongodiso ka kakaretso ba Gauteng e ne e le 67.3%.
tgt: Palogotlhe ya ikwadiso kwa Gauteng e ne e le kwa go 67.3%.

src: IEC e tlalehile hore jwale lenane la bakgethi le na le bakgethi ba 26 250 939, e leng se ka lekanang le 75% ya batho ba nang le tokelo ya ho kgetha, ho itshetlehilwe hodima dikgakanyong tsa Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) tsa dilemo tsa baahi.
tgt: IEC e begile gore lenaane la batlhophi ga jaana le eme ka batlhophi ba le 26 250 939, eo e batlileng e lekana le 75% ya baagi ba ba dumeletsweng go tlhopha, go ya ka diphopholetso tsa ngwaga oo o lekaneng go tlhopha wa Lefapha la Mananepalo la Aforika Borwa.

src: Baahi ba ka bang 300 000 ba etetseng diteishene tsa ho voutela, ba hara bakgethi ba ka fihlang ho milione bao IEC e neng e se na diaterese tsa bona pele ho mafelo ao a beke ya boingodiso.
tgt: Bokana ka baagi ba le 300 000 bao ba etetseng diseteišene tsa go tlhopha ba wela mo bokaneng ka milione ya batlhophi bao IEC e neng e sena diaterese tsa bona ka mafelo a beke.

src: Lenane la bakgethi le lokisitsweng ebile e le le nepahetseng le tiisa tshepahalo ya lenane la bakgethi mme le matlafatsa demokerasi ya rona ka ho netefatsa dikgetho tse lokolohileng, tse hlokang leeme ebile e le tse tshepahalang.
tgt: Lenaane la batlhophi le le tlhabolotsweng le nepagetse le netefatsa bonnete jwa lenaane la batlhophi le go matlafatsa temokerasi ya rona ka go netefatsa ditlhopho tse di gololesegileng, di sa tseye letlhakore ebile e le tsa nnete.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle a sa kgonang ho etela diteishene tsa ona tsa ho voutela mafelong a fetileng a beke, ho etela kantoro e haufi ya IEC ho ya netefatsa esita le ho lokisa diaterese tsa ona.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa go MaAforika Borwa otlhe ao a sa kgonang go etela diseteišene tsa bona tsa selegae mo mafelong a beke a a fetileng go etela kantoro ya IEC ya bona ya selegae go netefatsa le go tlhabolola diaterese tsa bona.

src: Ka nqa e nngwe, sesebedisuwa sa IEC sa inthanete ho WEBTOKEN le app ya yona, di dula di fumaneha ka dihora tse 24 ka letsatsi bakeng sa bakgethi ba ingodisitseng ho lekola le ho lokisa dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona.
tgt: Kgotsa, tirelo ya IEC ya inthanete mo go WEBTOKEN mme sediriswa se nna se le gona diura di le 24 ka letsatsi go batlhophi ba ba ikwadisitseng go tlhola le go tlhabolola dintlha tsa bona tsa aterese.

src: Ditakaletso tse ntle ho moatlelete Mhlengi Gwala.
tgt: Masego le pholo go moatleletetharo Mhlengi Gwala.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo, Mofumahadi Thokozile Xasa, mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe ketso ya bosoto ya tlhaselo kgahlanong le moatlelete ya motjha dilemong, Mhlengi Gwala, ya hlasetsweng ka sakga ya difate ha a ntse a palame baesekele KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Kabinete e ikamanya le Tona ya Metshameko le Boitapoloso, Moh Thokozile Xasa, mo go kgaleng ka bogale tiro ya bogatlapa ya tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le moatleletetharo yo mošwa Mhlengi Gwala, yoo a neng a tlhaselwa ka šaga fa a ne a palame baesekele kwa KwaZulu- Natal.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa moatlelete enwa hore a fole ka potlako mme e fetisetsa diteboho tse mofuthu ho moifo wa bongaka wa Sepetlele sa St Augustine o ntseng o mo hlokometse.
tgt: Kabinete e mo lakaletsa pholo ya ka bonako le go romela ditebogo go setlhopha sa dingaka seo se mo tlhokometseng kwa bookelong jwa St Augustine.

src: Ditlolo tsa molao ha di na sebaka setjhabeng sa habo rona mme Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao hore ho tshwarwe batlodi ba molao.
tgt: Bonokwane ga bo batlege mo setšhabeng sa rona mme Kabinete e ikuela go baagi go dira mmogo le ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao go tshwara dinokwane.

src: Komello e tsebahatswa e le koduwa ya naha.
tgt: Leuba le itsisiwe fa e le matlhotlhapelo a bosetšhaba.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Kopanelo ya Mmuso le Merero ya Botjhaba Zweli Mkhize, mmuso o tsebahaditse boemo ba naha ba koduwa ho sebetsana le bothata ba naha ba komello le metsi.
tgt: Ka fa tlase ga boeteledipele jwa Tona ya Merero ya Setso le Tirisanommogo ya Puso, Zweli Mkhize, puso e itsisitse maemo a bosetšhaba a matlhotlhapelo go mekamekana le mathata a metsi le leuba mo nageng.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa kananelo ya yona ho bao ba tswelang pele ho boloka metsi ka hara Aforika Borwa, esita le matsapa a sa sisinyeheng a entsweng ke Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng e mabapi le Komello, hammoho le ba amehang makaleng ohle a mmuso le a setjhaba, mabapi le ho sebetsana le maemo a sa sutheng a komello a thefutseng dikarolo tse ngatanyana tsa naha.
tgt: Kabinete e romela ditebogo go bao mo Aforika Borwa ba tswelelang go somarela metsi le matsapa a a sa feleng a a dirilweng ke Komiti ya Ditona tsa mo Nageng ya Leuba, mmogo le baamegi mo maphateng otlhe a puso le setšhaba, mo go mekamekaneng le maemo a a tsweletseng a leuba ao a tlhasetseng dikarolo di le mmalwa tsa naga.

src: Ntle le taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ke naha e haellwang ke metsi, Kabinete e kgodisehile hore re dula re ntse re le sebaka se ratwang ke bahahlaudi.
tgt: Ntle le gore Aforika Borwa ke naga e e tlhaelang ka metsi, Kabinete e netefaditse gore re santse re ntse re le lefelo la itlhophelo la bajanala.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Sehlomathisetso sa 1 se Hlomathisang Tumellano (Tshebedisano Botseteding) ya Porothokhole ya tsa Ditjhelete le Botsetedi (FIP) ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Aforika e ka Borwa (SADC) e tekwe Palamenteng bakeng sa kananelo.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Tumelano e e Mametlelelang Tlaleletso 1 (Tirisanommogo ya Peeletso) ya Phorotokolo ya Matlole le Peeletso (FIP) ya Dinaga Tlhabololo tsa Borwa jwa Aforika(SADC) e tlhagisiwe kwa Palamenteng go atlenegisiwa.

src: Sepheo sa FIP ke ho ntlafatsa maano a tsa ditjhelete le botsetedi a Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho, hore di tsamaisane le merero ya SADSena se tla netefatsa hore diphetoho dife kapa dife maanong a tsa ditjhelete le botsetedi Naheng e le nngwe eo e leng Setho ha di tlise diphetoho tse sa batleheng ho Dinaha tse ding tseo e leng Ditho.
tgt: Maikaelelo a FIP ke go tsamaisa mmogo dipholisi tsa matlole le peeletso tsa Dinaga tsa Maloko, gore di tle di tsamaisane le maikaelelo a SADSeno se tla netefatsa gore diphetogo dingwe le dingwe go dipholisi tsa matlole le peeletso mo Nageng e le nngwe ya Boloko ga e bake dipaakanyo tse di sa batlegeng mo Dinageng tse dingwe tsa Boloko.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho baballa tokelo ya mebuso ya ho laola dintho molemong wa setjhaba, esita le ho tsitsisa ditokelo le ditshwanelo tsa batsetedi le mebuso.
tgt: Diphetolo di ikaeletse go boloka tshwanelo ya dipuso go laola mo dikgatlhegong tsa setshaba, le go lekalekanya ditshwanelo le maikarabelo a babeeletsi le dipuso.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Melawana e Boemong bo Tlase e Shebilweng Botjha ya ba ya Rehwa Botjha ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) bakeng sa Tshwaro e Ntle ya Batshwaruwa (“Melawana ya Nelson Mandela”), Palamenteng.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go itsisiwe ga Melaopotlana ya ka Gale e e Ntšhwafaditsweng le go Itsegesešwa ya Ditšhaba Kopano (UN) tebang le Tlhokomelo ya Bagolegwa (“Melao ya Nelson Mandela”), kwa Palamenteng.

src: Ho rehwa botjha ha Melawana ya Boemo bo Tlase ya “Melawana ya Nelson Mandela” ho tlotla lefa la Moporesidente wa rona wa mehleng, ya qetileng dilemo tse 27 tjhankaneng.
tgt: Go fetola leina la Melaopotlana ya ka Gale go nna “Melao ya Nelson Mandela” go tlotla letlotlo la Moporesitente wa rona wa maloba, yoo a nnileng dingwaga di le 27 kwa kgolegelong.

src: Ho boetse ho bile le katoloso ya lefatshe ka bophara ya lepatlelo la Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Nelson Mandela, le hlomphuwang ke Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho tsa UN, ka la 18 Phupu, ho phahamisa maemo a botho a botshwaruwa, ho matlafatsa tlhokomediso mabapi le batshwaruwa hore ke karolo ya setjhaba esita le ho tlotla mosebetsi wa basebeletsi ba ditjhankana e le tshebeletso ya kahisano.
tgt: Go nnile gape le koketsego ya lefatshe ka bophara ya tiro ya Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba la Nelson Mandela, e dirilwe ke Dinaga tsa Maloko a UN ka 18 Phukwi, go tsweletsa maemo a setho a go nna mo kgolegelong, go tlhagisa tshedimosetso ka ga bagolegwa e le karolo ya setšhaba le boleng jwa tiro ya badiri ba kwa kgolegelong jaaka bodiredi loago.

src: Melawana ena e tla thusa Aforika Borwa ho akofisa diphetoho tse mabapi le tsamaiso ya batho ya ntshetsopele ya tshokollo ya batshwaruwa e tsamaisanang le dipehelo le ditataiso tse fapafapaneng tsa matjhaba.
tgt: Melao e tla thusa Aforika Borwa go itlhaganedisa phetogo go nna tsamaiso ya kgopololo e e tlhabololang batho eo e tsamaisanang le metheo le dikaedi tse di farologaneng tsa boditšhabatšhaba.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Melaotlhomo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Thibelo le Twantsho ya Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Lehloyo le Puo ya Lehloyo ya 2018 hore e tekwe Palamenteng.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go romelwa ga Molaotlhomo wa Thibelo le Twantsho ya Bosenyi jwa Letlhoo le Puo wa 2018 kwa Palamenteng.

src: Bili e habile ho bopa ditlolo tsa molao tsa lehloyo le puo ya lehloyo, esita le ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa ya ho thibela le ho lwantsha ditlolo tsena tsa molao.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o ikaelela go tlhama ditlolomolao tsa bosenyi jwa letlhoo le puo, le go baya mekgwa go thibela le go lwantsha ditlolomolao tseno.

src: E rerile ho sebetsana le dikgoka kgahlanong le batho ka lebaka la kgethollo.
tgt: E ikaelela go samagana le tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le batho go ya ka kgobelelo.

src: E tla boela e fana ka tshusumetso ditshwanelong tsa Aforika Borwa ho ya ka disebedisuwa tsa matjhaba tsa ditokelo tsa botho.
tgt: Gape e tla diragatsa maikarabelo a Aforika Borwa go ya ka melawana ya mekgwa ya ditshwanelo tsa boditšhabatšhaba tsa botho.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Setheo sa Naha sa Boitsebelo ba Inthanete sa iKamva (iNeSI) ya 2018 hore e kenngwe Palamenteng.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Molaotlhomo wa Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Bokgoni jwa Eleketeronoki sa iKamva (iNeSI) wa 2018 go ka romelwa kwa Palamenteng.

src: Bili e fana ka ho thehwa ha iNeSI jwaloka setheo se molaong se nang le boetsamolao boo e leng ba sona ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa bokgoni ba boitsebelo ba inthanete (boitsebelo ba dijithale) ka hara naha.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o letlelela gore go tlhomiwe iNesi jaaka setheo sa puso ka molao wa sona go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa bokgoni jwa eleketeroniki (bokgoni jwa dijithale) mo nageng.

src: Ntshetsopele ya bokgoni ba boitsebelo ba inthanete e nkuwa e le e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa mmuso mabapi le ho aha moruo o kenyeletsang bohle, esita le ho thea naha e nang le bokgoni ebile e le e tswelang pele.
tgt: Tlhabololo ya bokgoni ya e-skills e bonwa jaaka e nngwe ya dikgaolo tse di botlhokwa thata tsa puso go aga ikonomi e e akaretsang, le go tlhoma puso e e nang le bokgoni ebile e gola.

src: INeSI e tla sebetsa jwaloka sethusi sa tshebedisano le diphetoho, bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya boitsebelo ba dijithale le bokgoni ba ditlhophiso ka hara naha.
tgt: iNeSI e tla dira jaaka modiraphetolommogo wa naga le mofetola mawa, tebang le go tlhagisa bokgoni jwa dijithale le bokgoni jwa thulaganyo mo nageng.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Dibopeho tsa Metsing ya 2018 hore e lelekelwe Palamenteng.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go itsisiwe ga Molaotlhomo wa Hydrographic wa 2018 kwa Palamenteng.

src: Bili e habile ho ananela le ho fana ka maemo a ketsamolao Kantorong ya Setsebi sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing, eo esale e le teng ka hara Lefapha la Lebotho la Tshireletso (Lebotho la Lewatleng la Aforika Borwa) haesale ho tloha tshimolohong ya ditshebeletso tsa dibopeho tsa metsing ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o batla go lemoga le go neela maemo a molao go Kantoro ya Hydrographer, eo e sale e le gona kwa Lefapheng la Sesole (Sesole sa Metsi sa Aforika Borwa) e sale go tsenngwa ga ditirelo tsa hydrographic mo Aforika Borwa.

src: E tla thusa Setsebi sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing sa Lebotho la Lewatleng la Aforika Borwa ho ananelwa jwaloka Setsebi sa Naha sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing.
tgt: E tla kgontsha Hydrographer wa Sesole sa Metsi sa Aforika Borwa go lemogiwa jaaka Hydrographer wa Bosetšhaba.

src: E tla netefatsa hore phano ya ditshebeletso tsa dibopeho tsa metsing e ba ya semmuso mme e bopellwa ka hara molao.
tgt: E tla netefatsa gore motheo wa ditirelo tsa hydrographic e nna tsa semolao le go tsenngwa go nna molao.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Mawatle le Mmoka wa Matjhaba ya Polokeho ya Bophelo Mawatleng, e leng tumellano ya matjhaba ya tsa mawatleng e beang maemo a tlase a polokeho mabapi le kaho, thepa le tshebetso ya dikepe tsa kgwebo.
tgt: Seno ke go ya ka Mokgatlo wa Boditšhatšhaba wa Mawatle le Kopano ya Pabalesego ya Matshelo a kwa Lewatle, eo e leng tumelano ya boditšhabatšhaba ya mawatle eo e tlhalosang maemopotlana a pabalesego mo kagong, didiriswa le tiragatso ya dikepe tsa kgwebo.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.

src: Kgwedi/Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa BothoMekete ya sehopotso sa Kgwedi/Letsatsi la Naha la 2018 la Ditokelo tsa Botho e tla tshwarwa tlasa mokotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: ho phahamisa le ho tebisa tlwaelo ya ditokelo tsa botho setjhabeng ka bophara”.Ketsahalo ena ya naha e tla tshwarwa ka la 21 Hlakubele 2018 Lebaleng la Kirikete la George Thabe, Sharpeville ho la Vereeniging.
tgt: Letsatsi/Kgwedi ya Ditshwanelo tsa BothoMeletlo ya Letsatsi/Kgwedi ya Letsatsi la Bosetšhaba la Ditshwanelo tsa Botho la 2018 e tla tshwarwa ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: Ngwaga wa Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: go tsweletsa le go matlafatsa setso sa ditshwanelo tsa botho go ralala setšhaba”.Tiragalo ya bosetšhaba e tla tshwarwa ka di 21 Mopitlwe 2018 kwa Mabaleng a Khirikhete a George Thabe, Sharpeville kwa Vereeniging.

src: Kabinete e kopa makala ohle ho hlompha letsatsi lena la Naha, le ketekang setso sa ditokelo tsa botho sa Aforika Borwa esita le ho tlotla batho ba kang Madiba ya ileng a intsha sehlabelo molemong wa phihlello ya topollo le tokoloho tseo re nang le tsona kajeno.
tgt: Kabinete e kopa maphata otlhe go tlotla letsatsi leno la bosetšhaba, leo le ketekang setso sa Aforika Borwa sa ditshwanelo tsa botho le go tlotla batho ba ba jaaka Madiba yo o batlileng go swa le go ikentsha setlhabelo go fitlhelela kgololosego eo gompieno re e itumelelang.

src: Beke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya ImbizoBeke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo e tla ba ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ho la 15 Mmesa 2018 tlasa mokotaba o reng: “Re le mmoho re Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa Pele”.
tgt: Beke ya Matsholo a Tsepamisomogopolo a Bosetšhaba a ImbizoBeke ya Matsholo a Tsepamisomogopolo a Bosetšhaba a Imbizo e tla diragala go tloga ka 9 go ya go 15 Moranang 2018 ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Mmogo re isa Aforika Borwa kwa pele”.

src: Monongwaha, Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Mandela o bopa karolo e kgolo ya beke ya tsepamiso ya maikutlo, tlasa mookotaba o monyane o reng: “E ba karolo ya lefa”.
tgt: Monongwaga, meletlo ya Ngwagakgolo wa Mandela o dira karolo e kgolo ya beke ya beke ya tsepamisomogopolo, ka fa tlase ga setlhogwana: “Nna letlotlo”.

src: Ba Phethahatso ba tla buisana le setjhaba dikarolong tse fapaneng tsa naha.
tgt: Khuduthamaga e tla bo e buisana le baagi mo dikarolong tse di farologaneng tsa naga.

src: Mananeo a latelanang a Matona a tla tsebahatswa ha mmila o ntse o puta.
tgt: Mananeo a a farologaneng a Ditona a tla itsisiwe mo nakong e e sa fediseng pelo.

src: Kgiro ya Batjha Moporesidente Ramaphosa o lebeletswe ho thakgola bopulamadiboho ba kgato ya Ditshebeletso tsa Kgiro ya Batjha Setsing sa Thuthuhiso ya Dikgwebo sa Riversands ho la Diepsloot ka la 27 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga bašwa Moporesitente Ramaphosa o solofetse go tlhoma boitshimoledi jwa ntlha jwa Ditirelo tsa Thapo ya Bašwa kwa Setheong sa Thuthuso sa Riversands kwa Diepsloot ka di 27 Mopitlwe 2018.

src: Kgato ena, ka tshebedisano le lekala la poraefete, e habile ho matlafatsa batjha ba milione dilemong tse hlano tse tlang hore ba kene kgabong ya moruo, mohlomong e le ditho tsa setlamo sa basebetsi kapa ba itsamaisetsa dikgwebo tseo e leng tsa bona kapa ba iphumanele tjantjello ya seo ba ratang ho ntshetsa dithuto tsa bona pele ka sona.
tgt: Boitshimoledi, ke tirisanommogo le lephata la poraefete, leo le ikaelelang go matlafatsa bašwa ba le milione o le mongwe mo sebakeng sa dingwaga di le tlhano tse di latelang go nna le seabe mo ikonoming, e ka tswa e le jaaka leloko la badiri kgotsa ba tsamaisa dikgwebo tsa bona kgotsa ba bona se ba se ratang go tswelela ka go ithuta.

src: Maeto a tshebetso ho ya Mozambique le ZimbabweMoporesidente Ramaphosa o tla nka maeto a tshebetso ho ya Riphaboliking ya Mozambique le Riphaboliking ya Zimbabwe ka tatelano, ka Moqebelo wa la 17 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Diketelo tsa tiro go ya Mozambique le ZimbabweMoporesitente Ramaphosa o tla tsaya loeto la tiro go ya kwa Rephaboliki ya Mozambique le Rephaboliki ya Zimbabwe ka go latelana ka Lamatlhatso, 17 Mopitlwe 2018.

src: Maeto ana a tla tsepamisa maikutlo matlafatsang ya dikamano tsa dinahapedi le dinaha tse qollotsweng ka hodimo mona.
tgt: Diketelo di tla bo di lebeletse thata mo go matlafatseng dikamano tsa matlhakore oo mabedi le dinaga tse di umakilweng fa godimo.

src: Moporesidente o tla boela a thaka maikutlo ka dintho tse amanang kgotso le polokeho ka hara lebatowa esita le kontinenteng, a boele a tshohle ka dintlha tsa lefatshe tse molemong wa dinaha tsena.
tgt: Moporesitente gape o tla refosana dikakanyo ka ga merero ya kagiso le pabalesego mo kgaolong le mo kontinenteng, le go tswelela go buisana ka ga merero ya lefatshe eo botlhe ba e kgatlhegelang.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ntsiki Biyela, Mosadi wa pele wa motho e motsho wa Aforika Borwa wa serathodi sa veine ya thakgotseng veine ya letshwao la hae la boitsebahatso.
tgt: Kabinete e akgaola Ntsiki Biyela, mosadi wa ntlha wa motho montsho wa go dira beine mo Aforika Borwa yoo a tlhagisitseng kuno ya leina la gagwe.

src: Jwalokaha a na le lengolo la kgerata ya tsebo ya thitelo ya veine la Yunivesithing ya Stellenbosch hammoho le malebela a dilemo tse 13 a sebetsa, ka 2018 Diveini tsa hae tsa Aslina di tla rekisa dibotlolo tse 12 000 Dinaheng tse Kopaneng tsa Amerika, Jeremane, Taiwan le Ghana.
tgt: Ka gerata ya go ithuta ka morara le go dira beine go tswa kwa Unibesithing ya Stellenbosch le maitemogelo a tiro a dingwaga di le 13, Dibeini tsa gagwe tsa Asline di tla rekisa dibotlolo di le 1200.0 kwa Dinageng tse di Kopaneng tsa Amerika, Jeremane, Taiwan, le Ghana.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Caster Semenya ka ho roba rekoto ya Aforika Borwa ya 1 000m ya dilemo tse 35 mabelong a Athletix Grand Prix a neng a tshwaretswe Tuks ho la Pretoria.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Caster Semenya ka go roba rekoto ya Aforika Borwa ya 1000m eo e saleng e eme dingwaga di le 35 kwa kopanong ya Athletix Grand Prix e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Tuks mo Pretoria.

src: Thope ya rona ya pabala e hapile lebelo leo ka nako ya 2:35:44, a hlola rekoto ya kgale ya 1983 ya Ilze Wicksell ka metsotswana e ka bang e mmedi.
tgt: Mmagauta wa rona o fentse lobelo ka nako ya 2:35:44, a fenya rekoto ya kgale eo e beilweng ka 1983 ke Ilze Wicksell ka gaufi le metsotswana e le mebedi.

src: Kabinete e boela e thoholetsa Semenya ka ho fihlella peelo ya hae ya nako e telele ya ho fumana mangolo a thuto a yunivesithi, ha a ne a phethela lengolo la hae la Diploma ho tsa Saense ya Dipapadi Yunivesithing ya Leboya Bophirima ho la Potchefstroom.
tgt: Kabinete gape e opela Semenya diatla ka go diragatsa maikaelelo ao e leng kgale a na le ona a go bona borutegi jwa yunibesithi fa a ne a fetsa Dipoloma mo go Saense ya Metshameko kwa Yumibesithing ya Bokone Phirima kwa Potchefstroom.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho metswalle le ba lelapa ba Setho se Hlomphehang sa Palamente, Mofumahadi Loliwe Fazeka, ya hlokahaletseng kotsing ya koloi Kapa Botjhabela, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshidiso go ditsala le balosika ba Leloko le le Tlotlegang la Palamente, Moh Loliwe Fazeka, yoo o neng a tlhokafala mo kotsing ya sejanaga kwa Kapa Botlhaba, beke e e fetileng.

src: Kabinete e boela e fetisa matshediso a yona ho baratuwa ba Lenqosa la Aforika Borwa naheng ya Sweden, Mofumahadi Faith Radebe, ya hlokahetseng ka Labobedi, mohla la 13 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e romela matshidiso go balosika ba Moambasetara wa Aforika Borwa go Sweden, Moh Faith Radebe, yo o tlhokafetseg ka Labobedi, 13 Mopitlwe 2018.

src: Pele ho moo e ne e le Mohlahlobi-Kakaretso wa Mautlwela Aforika Borwa.
tgt: O ne pejana a dira jaaka Motlhatlhobikakaretso wa Matlhale wa Aforika Borwa.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang ya tlhathlobisiso.
tgt: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragala fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi.

src: Ngaka Philemon Mjwara e le Motsamaisi-Kakaretso wa Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa Mofumahadi Memme Sejosengwe e le Mongodi-Kakaretso Kantorong ya Moahlodi e Moholo bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa Mofumahadi Thuli E Radebe, e le Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso Setsing sa Ntlafatso ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dikgwedi tse tsheletseng.
tgt: Ng Philemon Mjwara jaaka Mokaedikakaretso wa Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji ka konteraka e e okeditsweng ya sebaka sa dingwaga di le tharo, e simolola ka 1 Moranang 1 April Moh Memme Sejosengwe jaaka Mokwaledikakaretso wa Kantoro ya Moatlhodimogolo ka konteraka ya nako e e okeditsweng ya dingwaga di le tharo, e simolola go tloga ka 1 Moranang Moh Thuli E Radebe, jaaka Mokaedikhuduthamaga kwa the Centre of Public Service Innovation for an extended contract period of six months.

src: Monghadi Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete wa Setheo sa Naha sa Mehlodi ya Ditaba tsa Elektroniki sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Rre Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa jaaka Motlhankedimoolo wa Matlotlo wa Setheo sa Bobegakgang jwa Eleketeroniki jwa Bosetshaba jwa Aforika Borwa.

tgt: Boto ya Sentech SOC Limited:a. Rre Magatho Mello (o thapilwe gape jaaka mokaedi yo e seng leloko la khuduthamaga le Modulasetilob.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro mohla la 25 Mmesa 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDitaba tsa Tikoloho.
tgt: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka la bo, 25 Moranang 2018, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.

src: Mapato a baitseki le mekaubere.
tgt: Poloko ya bagale le bagaka.

src: Kabinete e leboha batho bohle lefatsheng ka bophara, haholoholo maAforika Borwa, ka karabelo ya bona e mofuthu ebile e le mosa nakong ya ho hlokahala ha ‘imbokodo’ Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Moitseki wa ntwa ya tokoloho Ngaka Zola Skweyiya le moetapele wa mokgatlo wa basebetsi Archie Sibeko.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga batho botlhe go ralala le lefatshe ka bophara, bogolosegolo maAforika Borwa, ka tsibogelo ya bona e e mofutho le botho fa go ne go itsesewe gore ‘imbokodo’ Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, mogale wa Kgaratlhelo ya Kgololesego Ngaka Zola Skweyiya mmogo le molweladitshwanelo tsa badiri Archie Sibeko ba latswitse kika.

src: Baitseki ba rona ba nyehetse maphelo a bona boikitlaetsong ba Aforika Borwa e ntlafetseng, mme banna le basadi ba naha ya rona ba kgothatswa ba bile ba susumetswa ke ditshotleho tsa bona.
tgt: Bagale ba rona ba ineetse matshelo a bona mo torong ya go dira gore Aforika Borwa e nne naga e e botoka mme baagi ba rona mo nageng ba rotloediwa ke ka fao ba kgaratlhileng ka teng.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho iseng hlompho ho mofu Mokaubere wa modiplomate, Moambasadara George Nene, ya sebeleditseng Aforika Borwa ka bokgabane le boitelo nakong ya hae ya ha a ne a le palehong, ho ngoka lebatowa le kontinente ya rona ho netefatsa tokoloho ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kabinete gape e ikgolaganya le Moporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa mo go supeng tlotlo mo go Mogaleng ono wa modipolomate, Moambasatara George Nene, yo a diretseng Aforika Borwa ka boineelo le ka botswapelo mo nakong ya fa a ne a le kwa botshabelo mo go golaganyeng kgaolo le kontinente ya rona go ka sireletsa kgololesego ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Biopelaetso ba Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Ditshupetso tsa kwa Bokone Bophirima.

src: Kabinete e sekasekile boemo bo hlokang botsitso bo ropohileng Leboya Bophirima, bo ammeng ditshebeletso tse ngatanyana, haholoholo ditshebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle.
